name: Task Force Omega
description: Task Force Omega is a joint Starfleet-KDF operation dedicated to stopping the advance of the Borg Collective.

name: Temporal Operative
description: Temporal Operatives can carefully manipulate the fabric of reality to turn probability and causality on its head, shifting the tide of battle in their favor.

name: New Romulus
description: Romulans who have broken free from the oppression of the Tal Shiar have gathered together on New Romulus to create a new homeworld and a new government. The Republic needs help from their Starfleet and KDF allies to settle the planet and defend it from threats.

name: Commando
description: Specialized in ground assaults, and making the most of your weaponry and equipment.

name: Intelligence Officer
description: Specializes in finding weaknesses in foes and remaining undetected, while countering the same.

name: Pilot
description: Pushing the upper limits of starship maneuverability.

name: Strategist
description: Experts in developing and adapting battlefield plans, Strategists are prized for their ability to react to the conditions of multi-ship combat.

name: Nukara Strikeforce
description: Nukara Strikeforce is a task force dedicated to eradicating the Tholian threat on Nukara Prime and throughout the quadrant.

name: Miracle Worker
description: Miracle Workers are the galaxy's best, using their ingenuity and years of experience to come up with creative solutions to abnormal problems and know the real limitations on their equipment.

name: Constable
description: Centers on a unique mechanic - your Antagonist.

name: Command Officer
description: Leaders and Generals, the Command Officer is trained to improve the effectiveness and coordination of those under their command.
